body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seacrest Beach "Barefoot Bungalow" 87 The Greenway Loop Seacrest Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-082518 Bedrooms 3 Beds 4 Sleeps 6 Full Baths 2 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Walking distance to the beach - Access to the 12,000-square-foot community pool - Complimentary Shuttle Service to the beach March 2-October 31 - Propane grill - Wireless Internet - 3 Adult Bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Please note this community requires a Guest Registration Form to be completed within two weeks of arrival to access the community amenities. DETAILS: Barefoot Bungalow is an adorable 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom Seacrest Beach home with refined interiors that sleeps 6. Guests will enjoy the home’s two spacious porches and access to a 12,000 -square-foot community pool and seasonal shuttle service to the beach. A shaded front porch with cushioned chairs and overhead fans welcomes guests to Barefoot Bungalow. Stepping inside, guests discover elegant coastal interiors with white shiplap wainscoting, hickory hardwood floors, and luxurious finishes. The spacious kitchen has views of the front porch, beautiful quartz countertops, a 4-burner gas range, and lots of space to prepare meals and store beach snacks. An elegant dining table divides the kitchen from the living area, which is decorated in soothing tones of gray and taupe. Guests can unwind from a fun day in the sun on one of the comfortable sofas and enjoy a favorite show on a 55” Smart TV equipped with a SONOS surround sound system. French doors from the living area open to an expansive back porch with a lovely outdoor dining table and a gas grill, making it simple to dine al fresco. Off the living area are two guest bedrooms that share a bathroom and the primary bedroom. Younger guests will love the bright surfing theme of a guest bedroom with two twin beds. A second guest bedroom has a full/queen bed with an upholstered headboard and beaded chandelier. Guests staying in the primary bedroom will find a calming, all-white space with a beautiful king bed, beaded chandelier, and French doors that open to the back porch. The bedroom’s private bathroom has marble tile, a glass-enclosed shower, and custom cabinets. Guests can walk to many shops and restaurants in Seacrest Beach or explore nearby Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach on 3 included adult bikes. With its gorgeous interiors and fabulous location, Barefoot Bungalow will book quickly. Book today!
